definitions.explanation: The short hairs growing on the edge of the eyelids.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{睫毛|まつげ}が{長|なが}くて{綺麗|きれい}だ。
{睫毛|まつげ}が{目|め}に{入|はい}って{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: An eyelash got in my eye and it hurts.

examples.japanese: マスカラで{睫毛|まつげ}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I curled my eyelashes with mascara.

notes:
{睫毛|まつげ} (eyelash) is commonly written in hiragana as まつげ or まつ毛.

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {睫|まつげ} is rarely used. Most often written as まつげ, まつ毛, or 睫毛.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {睫毛|まつげ}が{長|なが}い (have long eyelashes)
- {睫毛|まつげ}を{上|あ}げる (curl eyelashes)
- {付|つ}け{睫毛|まつげ} (false eyelashes)
- {睫毛|まつげ}エクステ (eyelash extensions)

BEAUTY CONTEXT:
- マスカラ (mascara)
- ビューラー (eyelash curler)
- {睫毛|まつげ}パーマ (eyelash perm)

EYE AREA:
- {眉|まゆ} / {眉毛|まゆげ} (eyebrow)
- {睫毛|まつげ} (eyelash)
- {瞼|まぶた} (eyelid)
